title.narrative: Life-saving intervention in Southern Haiti to support IDPs fleeing violence

description.narrative: The project will support both newly arrived and displaced individuals in Les Cayes and the host Communities. A total of 5,000 individuals (1,000 HHs) will be targeted by this project, including the elderly, people with disabilities, unaccompanied minors, pregnant and lactating women and GBV survivors. Activities will include: 1.Multi-purpose cash distribution : 21,300 (roughly $160USD) Haitian Gourds will be be provided in the local currency to each of 1000 HH for one round, in one location 2. Wash & Hygiene Promotion: The project will tackle the risk of cholera and other water-borne diseases through provisions of both in-kind WASH/hygiene kits and hygiene sensitization activities to reach 4000 people. 3. Protection : Recognizing the traumatized state of the affected population, the partnership will work closely with the local professionals, to deliver much-needed psychosocial support and trauma counselling services for 2500 people, with a focus on women and girls and others with specific protection needs. 4. Enhance knowledge of 500 Host households on information related to protective measures, referrals to protection specialists, to ensure their health and safety
